title: Feature Engineering Assistant: an interactive desktop workbench for transparent feature engineering and impact evaluation
description: Open-source Python/Tkinter desktop application for dataset profiling, automated cleaning, latent feature generation (PCA, ICA, tabular autoencoder), manual pruning, supervised feature selection, a Latent Features Explorer and cross-validated stage-wise impact evaluation with significance tests. Includes a reproducibility capsule (paper_assets/) that regenerates all results and figures of the accompanying SoftwareX paper.
